cap: Reproductive aging runs from a prepubertal ovary with 1 to 2 million follicles at birth, through regular ovulatory cycles, to an early transition in which cycles shorten and vary by 7 days or more, a late transition with gaps of 60 days or more, and postmenopause. FSH fluctuates before it settles high, which is why one value cannot confirm or exclude the transition. The final menstrual period, stage 0, is recognized only after 12 months without menses.
